contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IVLIA AVGVSTA ; R/ PIETAS AVGG

Copper alloy with silver wash. Coin: Silver washed copy Denarius of Julia Domna (193-217), possibly imitating an issue of Rome mint of 204. Obverse description: Bust draped and coiffed right. Obverse inscription: IVLIA AVGVSTA. Reverse description: Pietas left sacrificing over altar. Reverse inscription: PIETAS AVGG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.4mm, weight: 2.51gms, die…
